Tool bag consisting of a wrench set (open-end, ring) and assorted screwdrivers
Body test set, dryer
Collect the cylinders at the equipment body test set0
Fill the cylinders with water using the water pump of the set, then fit the coupling to the cylinders0
Move the test valve to the Test position and open the test water source and the main air source0
Operate the body test set to start the test for 5 extinguishers in one batch up to a pressure of 250 bar
Leave the cylinder under this pressure for 5 minutes; after the test succeeds, release the pressure by moving the test valve to the Release position
Remove the powder cylinders, empty them of water and dry them well with a special dryer.
Refill the powder cylinders with new ones and check that their pressure has become ideal0
Seal the valves of the cylinders0
Inspect the powder hoses and the nitrogen inlet to the trailer tank and check that there are no cracks in them0
Inspect the regulator to check that there is no leakage. 0
Check the cleanliness of the nozzle of the hose.
Check that the hose couplings are firmly fixed.
Check the serviceability of the trailer chassis, trailer wheels, hose boxes and powder tank, and carry out the necessary scraping and painting.
Change the dry chemical powder of the trailer every five years according to the powder shelf life0

Introduction
This document sets out the inspection steps every five years for dry chemical powder trailers of 250 kg and 500 kg capacity; dry chemical powder is used to extinguish all types of fires
